about_the_game:
Ever been annoyed by some wasps? Let's go to WAR with them!

  • Linear, easy to get into (but hard to master) fun!

  • 2 guns to switch between during play

  • Lots of bosses!

  • Handcrafted pixel art visuals

Wasp Wars: New Wasp Order is a linear action shooter based on Contra and other retro shooter games of old, with 360 aim, including analog stick aiming on controller. This game contains 12 total stages, with original music based on classic 16-bit FM and sample-based music that we've come to love.

At your disposal is the rifle; a fast-firing, accurate weapon best suited for precision, a shotgun; a slower firing, but pack-punching weapon, and 4 grenades (per stage); great for clearing screens of too many enemies, or hitting heavier to bosses. The grenades you save will be counted for bonus HP at the end of each level, to boot! You can select which level you want to play between each completed stage, but only the levels you have already beaten (and the next one to beat!) are unlocked. 

Story

Three soldiers set out on an expedition to the desolate Katag-Lupan Island Wasp Base to try and recover valuable information as to where those pesky wasps have gone.. But not all goes well for them. Once again our main-man Marine must find the Wasp Headquarters, try to save the lost team of soldiers, and exterminate the wasps once and for all! Blast through the rooftops of The Big City, down to the war-torn city outskirts, inside the city's hijacked mining operation, through the mountainside jungle, and more!
